instagram.caption:
The size you are not right now.
The Dresser Drawers in the Primary Bedroom. These drawers hold the folded clothes you wear this season, split into categories you can find without digging.

What done looks like:
1. Each drawer holds one category: underwear and socks
2. Workout clothes. Everything folded to stand upright so you read the whole drawer from above when it opens. A hand's width of free space in each drawer
3. Every drawer slides shut without you pressing anything down first

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success dresser drawers.
